course_name_original: Electric Power Stations and Substations Engineering
course_name_en: Electric Power Stations and Substations Engineering
prerequisites: Technique of higher voltages and Short circuits

learning_outcomes.text: Gain knowledge needed to rational design and use the electrical part of power stations.

syllabus_topics: Exploitation regimes of work for distribution systems.
Heating and electrodynamics act of current-carrying parts and machines.
Electrical machinery for high voltage in distribution systems.
Electrical scheme, construction realization and structure of distribution systems.
teaching_methods: Discussions with media and commercial company materials
assessment_rules: The discipline ends with an exam which includes two themes for written answer and oral discussion. Current control is based on student answers during laboratory exercises.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS FEEA (datos antiguos; ver notas)
